These are the exceptions: we used each one for a month without paying, and none of them got in our way. The tools, in the order we would set them up, each with its own review. Ljud Studio sound for calls and recordings. Audio macOS, Windows Free Ritmo A calendar that protects your focus time. Productivity Web, iOS, Android Free Lente Product photos from a phone snapshot. Image Web, iOS Freemium Voce Natural voiceovers in 30 languages. Audio Web, API Freemium Ramo Code review that reads the whole repository.
